prompt.project_info: Create a clean minimalist indoor lifestyle portrait of an approved adult woman standing against a neutral wall.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with wavy blonde hair, a warm friendly closed-lip smile, and approachable direct gaze. She stands upright with relaxed shoulders, head slightly tilted, arms relaxed near her sides, and weight shifted naturally to one leg. She wears a solid dark long-sleeve mini dress in smooth stretch fabric with a flattering scoop or sweetheart neckline.
prompt.composition_elements: 3:4 medium portrait from mid-thigh to head, eye-level natural perspective, subject sharp against a smooth light-neutral minimal wall, clean negative space, and simple modern social-media framing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Even diffused frontal room light with soft shadows and gentle highlights, neutral-warm low-to-medium contrast, natural saturation, clean lifestyle mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-resolution portrait lens, shallow background softening, realistic fabric and skin texture, natural anatomy and hands, minimal sensor noise, subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a clean photorealistic 3:4 indoor lifestyle portrait of an approved adult woman with wavy blonde hair, a warm friendly closed-lip smile, and approachable direct gaze. She stands upright against a smooth light-neutral wall with relaxed shoulders, head slightly tilted, arms resting naturally near her sides, and weight shifted subtly to one leg. She wears a solid dark long-sleeve mini dress in smooth stretch fabric with a flattering scoop or sweetheart neckline. Use eye-level natural perspective, mid-thigh-to-head framing, clean negative space, even diffused frontal room light, soft shadows, neutral-warm low-to-medium contrast, natural saturation, realistic fabric and skin, and subtle grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, text, logo
